title: Three-Dimensional Globe and Shell Viewer
note: browser frontend is spec-level, backend API tested
negative_results: The 3D globe frontend (CesiumJS/React) is NOT built in the pytest gate; it is delivered as a UI specification against the shared P57 backend service API (same contract as P58).
No cwatlas code, tests, or schemas were modified; docs only.
The viewer adds only view-layer concerns (camera, shell layers, face overlays); it holds no geodesy, codec, or claim logic.

claims.statement: The globe reuses the P48 vector-to-pin state machine and the P57 service unchanged; shells 0..8 render with nonliteral SOURCE-ontology labels, not measured altitudes.
An icosahedral face or recursive cell is a synthetic tessellation cell, not a place; face ids and dodecahedron vertex ids are distinct graphs and are not conflated.
Radial bands and effective-potential ordinals are nonliteral re-expressions of shell index, never physical potentials (refuse_effective_potential_as_physical).
The 8<->0 shell closure is source ontology and is never auto-applied; the viewer draws it only on explicit opt-in.
Uncertainty regions render by RegionKind (CIRCLE/ELLIPSE/CELL_POLYGON); no zero-area point is drawn for an uncalibrated decode.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
